# Vendored libraries

- `zxing-library.min.js`: [@zxing/library](https://github.com/zxing-js/library) 0.23.0 (Apache-2.0, see `ZXING-LICENSE.txt`), the UMD build. Reads UPC/EAN, Code 128/39/93, ITF, Codabar, QR, Data Matrix, Aztec and PDF417 from camera frames. Loaded on demand, only when someone taps a camera button.
